title: Running Commentary on Torah 59 — Mekarev B'nei Adam
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 59 — מקרב בני אדם
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"α. One who constantly strives to **bring others to avodas Hashem** must guard himself that the **klipos and ra of those he draws-near do not cleave to him**. Such a person = builds **heichal ha'kodesh**. **Kodesh** = **'v'ha'nosar bi'Yrushalayim kadosh yei'amer lo'** (Yeshayahu 4:3) — i.e., those who remain cleaving to **yirah shleimah** via him. Though **many klipos v'dinim** oppose and **seek to cleave**."**

intermediate.en: **α. One who brings others near must guard from **klipos/ra** of mekuravim. Such = builds **heichal ha'kodesh** (Yesh 4:3 "ha'nosar kadosh yei'amer").
intermediate.he: **α. מקרב חייב להישמר מ**קליפות/רע** של מתקרבים. בונה **היכל הקודש** (יש' ד, ג "הנותר קדוש ייאמר").

beginner.en: **"β. The **esh of this malach** (protecting him) is made via **bechina of mishpat** — judging oneself (**y'chalkel devarav b'mishpat**). **'Ki b'eish Hashem nishpat'** (Yeshayahu 66:16). Mishpat in the lev (**'v'nasa Aharon es mishpat b'nei Yisrael al libo tamid,'** Shemos 28:30). Then **'yotzei la'ohr mishpat'** — the lev flames, sits on **kisei** (**'konein la'mishpat kis'o,'** Tehillim 9:8) = **kisei kavod** (Yirmiyahu 17:12 **'kisei kavod'**). **'Tamoch ashurai b'mag'losecha'** (Tehillim 17:5) = mishpat/ashurai."**

intermediate.en: **β. Malach-esh from mishpat** (Yesh 66:16; Shem 28:30; Teh 9:8; Yir 17:12; Teh 17:5).
intermediate.he: **β. מלאך-אש מהמשפט** (יש' סו, טז; שמ' כח, ל; תה' ט, ח; יר' יז, יב; תה' יז, ה).

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. יש' סו, טז; שמ' כח, ל; תה' ט, ח; יז, ה; יר' יז, יב.

beginner.en: **"γ. **Shmiras Shabbos**: Hakd Zohar 5b: **'es Shab'sosai tishmoru'** — **'Shab'sosai = igula v'ribua di'l'go.'** **Igula=kisei ha'kavod** (**'v'rosh agol la'kisei'**); **ribua=mishpat** (Shemos 28:16 **'ravu'a yihyeh kaful'** = choshen ha'mishpat). In **weekday, Shechinah sifts birurim**; **on Shabbos she rests**. L'asid = **yom she'kulo Shabbos** (all ra nullified). Via **igula+ribua** — ra is broken."**

intermediate.en: **γ. Shmiras Shabbos = "igula v'ribua di'l'go"** (Hakd Zohar 5b). Igula=kisei; ribua=mishpat (Shem 28:16). Weekday=sifting; Shabbos=rest. L'asid="yom she'kulo Shabbos."
intermediate.he: **γ. שמירת שבת = "עיגולא ורבועא דלגו"** (הקד' זוה"ק ה:). עיגול=כיסא; ריבוע=משפט (שמ' כח, טז). חול=ברור; שבת=שביתה. לעתיד="יום שכולו שבת".

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. הקד' זוה"ק ה:; שמ' כח, טז.

beginner.en: **"δ. **Bitul ha'issur b'shishim** (issur batel in 60). **Shishim=igula=samech** (circle-letter). **Kisei kavod** (**'v'es melachim l'kisei,'** Iyov 36:7); **'shishim heimah malachos'** (Shir 6:8). Issur (klipah) is batel via **kis'os la'mishpat**. **'Ein zocher ela igula'** — visible openly, **ribua covered by igula**. Samech's koach comes from mem (ribua) — **'arba'im yakenu'** (Devarim 25:3). Samech receives from mem, which is kis'os la'mishpat."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Bitul b'60=igula=samech=kisei** (Iyov 36:7; Shir 6:8). Issur/klipah batel via **kis'os la'mishpat**. Samech from mem (ribua; Dev 25:3 "arba'im").
intermediate.he: **δ. ביטול בס'=עיגול=סמ"ך=כיסא** (איוב לו, ז; שה"ש ו, ח). איסור בטל ע"י **כיסאות למשפט**. סמ"ך ממ"ם (ריבוע; דב' כה, ג "ארבעים").

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. איוב לו, ז; שה"ש ו, ח; דב' כה, ג.

beginner.en: **"ε. **'V'nasati lahem b'veisi u'v'chomosai yad v'shem tov mi'banim u'mi'banos'** (Yeshayahu 56:5). **Yad v'shem dayka** — in merit of **shmiras Shabbos** (igula+ribua). **Yad=ribua=mishpat** (**'v'sochez b'mishpat yadi,'** Devarim 32:41). **Shem=igula** (**'yancheni b'ma'aglei tzedek l'ma'an shmo,'** Tehillim 23:3). **Yad**=koach to **establish fit talmidim** + draw in them ru'ach chochmah, **'vi'Yhoshua bin Nun malei ru'ach chochmah,'** Devarim 34:9)."**

intermediate.en: **ε. "Yad v'shem" b'Yesh 56:5** = shmiras Shabbos. Yad=ribua/mishpat (Dev 32:41); shem=igula (Teh 23:3). Yad=koach to establish talmidim+ru'ach chochmah (Dev 34:9).
intermediate.he: **ה. "יד ושם" ביש' נו, ה** = שמירת שבת. יד=ריבוע/משפט (דב' לב, מא); שם=עיגול (תה' כג, ג). יד=כוח להעמיד תלמידים+רוח חכמה (דב' לד, ט).

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. יש' נו, ה; דב' לב, מא; לד, ט; תה' כג, ג.

beginner.en: **"ζ. Know: there are **resha'im one may NOT mekarev** — they **drag the mekarev down**. Like Moshe who mekarev the **eirev rav** — afterwards HKBH said: **'lech rad ki shichet amcha'** (Shemos 32:7). No koach in mishpat to subdue their ra. Without mishpat, great kilkul both in the **malachim** + in **igula v'ribua**."** **"**Peirush (Shabbos 31a)**: **'mipnei mah eineihem shel Tarmodim terutos?'** — **Tarmod** = **resha'im who shouldn't be mekarev**."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Resha'im NOT to mekarev** — they drag down. Moshe-eirev rav (Shem 32:7). Shab 31a "Tarmodim terutos" — resha'im.
intermediate.he: **ו. רשעים שאין לקרב** — גוררים למטה. משה-ערב רב (שמ' לב, ז). שב' לא "תרמודים טרוטות" — רשעים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. שמ' לב, ז; שב' לא.

beginner.en: **R"N bracket**: **"**'Tlas nafkin mi'chad'** in siman 58, + this Torah of **heichal ha'kodesh** — **both were said as one Torah on the pasuk 'Ashrei ha'am yod'ei teru'ah.'** Afterwards when he wrote them, he **split into two Torahs**. When he gave me to copy, he told me he'd split them. I understood he had a kavanah, and Hashem knows it."**

intermediate.en: R"N: T58 + T59 = originally **one Torah** on "Ashrei ha'am yod'ei teru'ah"; split into 2 b'kavanah.
intermediate.he: ר"נ: ת"ח + ת"ט = במקור **תורה אחת** על "אשרי העם"; חלקן לב'.
